title: Senior Customer Engineer Middle East, Oil & Gas
description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Customer Engineer Middle East, Oil & Gas to lead technical pre-sales across our National Oil Company (NOC) engagements in the region. Working alongside our Value Advisor for energy, you will own the technical relationship with NOC customers, translating their operational challenges into Armada solutions across edge compute, sovereign AI, and disconnected/denied-environment use cases. This role covers the regional NOC portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own technical pre-sales for regional NOC accounts: discovery, solution design, demos, proofs of concept, and technical proposals.
  • Maintain accountability for the pre-sale design of integrated edge solutions, including an enclosure appropriate for physical site constraints, hardware requirements sized for workloads, network strategy for local data transfer and remote backhaul, and the application (first- or third-party) deployment approach.
  • Translate upstream, midstream, and downstream operational use cases (e.g. real-time field analytics, edge AI at remote sites, data sovereignty) into Armada architectures.
  • Lead and document proofs of concept, partnering with product, delivery, and partner engineering teams.
  • Remain the customer’s technical point of contact through implementation, partnering with delivery on execution.
  • Act as the trusted technical advisor to customer engineering and IT/OT stakeholders, building credibility at both working and decision-maker levels.
  • Position Armada’s Galleon, Atlas, and Bridge platforms and the Microsoft Azure Local / NVIDIA / Qualcomm stack against alternatives, articulating differentiation on sovereignty, speed, and scale.
  • Develop and maintain deep working knowledge of Armada’s partner ecosystem, their products, software, technology stacks, and how they integrate with Armada, and design joint solutions that combine Armada and partner technologies.
  • Act as the technical interface to partners and system integrators on shared NOC engagements, aligning architectures and dividing technical scope.
  • Support bid and RFP responses with technical content, architecture diagrams, solution selection (hardware and software) and effort estimates.
  • Partner closely with Account Executives and the energy Value Advisor to advance pipeline and shorten technical sales cycles.
  • Feed customer and field insights back to product management to shape the roadmap for energy use cases.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of pre-sales, solution architecture, or customer/sales engineering experience, including direct experience in the oil & gas sector. Oil & gas domain experience is a hard requirement for this role.
  • Strong grasp of edge computing, data center infrastructure, cloud, and/or AI/ML solution architecture.
  • Ability to lead technical conversations with both engineering teams and senior decision-makers.
  • Experience scoping and running proofs of concept and writing technical proposals.
  • Familiarity with the GCC / MEA energy landscape and NOC procurement and operating environments.
  • Comfort working within a multi-partner ecosystem; quickly learning partner and integrator products and stitching them into coherent end-to-end architectures.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; willingness to travel across the region.

Preferred

  • Hands-on exposure to OT/IIoT, remote and disconnected operations, or data sovereignty requirements.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure (incl. Azure Local) and/or NVIDIA AI and/or Qualcomm infrastructure.
  • Arabic language skills.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first six months, you will have built credible technical relationships across the regional NOC portfolio, delivered at least one reference-grade proof of concept, and become the go-to technical authority for energy engagements alongside the Value Advisor. Performance will be measured against concrete targets, including [technical-win rate / pipeline supported / average technical-phase cycle time], agreed with your manager in your first 30 days.

You're a Great Fit if You're

  • A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge
  • A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company
  • A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda
  • Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive. As an equal opportunity employer, we strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment based on race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, and compensation. Our hiring is guided by qualifications, merit, and the business needs at the time.

Unsolicited Resumes and Candidates

Armada does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies or recruiters. All candidates must apply directly through our careers page. Any resumes submitted by agencies without a prior signed agreement will be considered unsolicited and Armada will not be obligated to pay any fees.

title: Manager, Monitoring & Site Management (CRA Team)
location: Germany,  Hungary,  Ireland,  Poland,  Romania,  UK
description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

ABOUT ALIMENTIV

Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.

We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you.

THE OPPORTUNITY

In this role, you will lead the day-to-day delivery of our Clinical Monitoring capability, with a focus on European CRAs. You will bring structure, clarity, and accountability to how we plan, manage, and continuously improve this critical function.

Your scope spans both operational leadership and strategic impact. From shaping policies and strengthening processes, to ensuring the quality and integrity of our clinical work at every level, you will play a central role. You will oversee resource planning, performance management, and compliance, ensuring our teams and partners deliver consistently high standards aligned with both regulatory expectations and industry best practice.

Working closely with sponsors and research partners, you will act as a trusted representative of our clinical monitoring and project teams throughout the full study lifecycle. You will bring expertise, credibility, and a solutions-oriented mindset to every interaction.

Positions available: 1; this opportunity is cross-listed in multiple locations. At this time, the position is open to those residing in Germany, United Kingdom, Ireland, Poland, Hungary, and Romania.

Closing date: June 12th, 2026, or later until successful candidate identified.

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Project Planning

  • Working in conjunction with clinical monitoring and project leadership team members, identify, develop, plan for, monitor, approve and/or report on project specific processes and services related to site selection, clinical monitoring, ICH-GCP compliance issue resolution, and global project harmonization including SOP and QS document maintenance, periodic site visits and collaborating with IT support to meet sponsor requirements on a timely basis.

Customer Service Delivery

  • Represent and support the Clinical Monitoring teams with internal partners and external Sponsors to identify areas of improvement, to address sponsor/site concerns and to integrate new technologies and processes.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance, industry best practices, and organizational goals and targets are met and/or exceeded.

Team Management and Engagement

  • Manage members of the Clinical Monitoring teams, ensuring functional areas are adequately staffed with qualified personnel, providing ongoing support to staff in the areas of work allocation, resource planning, training and development, technology, process development, expense management, employee engagement and performance management (staff role development, evaluations, performance improvement and lost time management).

Third Party Contract Management

  • Identify, procure, and manage Clinical Monitoring (Clinical Operations Leads) Independent Contractor services, including needs assessment, recruitment, contract negotiations, Corporate and Sponsor policy compliance, training and development, cost monitoring and performance management, ensuring corporate, industry and regulatory service level, guidelines and regulations are maintained.

Product/Service Delivery Support

  • Provide expertise, developing tools to support project teams and business development in the areas of clinical, site and compliance monitoring and performance during the project life cycle starting from the bidding process through to reporting project findings to sponsors.

Qualifications

  • The successful candidate should have a College Diploma/University Degree in a relevant field (Health Sciences, Life Sciences preferred, or SoCRA and/or ACRP Certification/Designation) and a minimum of 4-6 years related experience + substantial on-going training.
  • Experience in managing CRA staff and ability to provide training and/or mentorship to colleagues on a 1:1 basis or meeting setting.
  • Ability to work in a remote global capacity
  • Strong knowledge of appropriate regulations and guidelines as they pertain to clinical monitoring and GCP.
  • Team player that has a customer service approach and is solution oriented.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills
  • Strong verbal, written, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Working Conditions

  • Home-based

title: Coordinator, Clinical Operations

title: Growth Marketing Manager, Paid Social - Canada
description:

Summary

Join Jobscan as our Growth Marketing Manager, Paid Social, and build our next major acquisition channel. Search has powered our growth for years. Now we’re investing in social, and you’ll be the person who makes it work.

This is a hands-on ownership role for a performance marketer who loves being in the ad account every day, not a passive management seat. You will own paid social end to end, starting with Meta: strategy, budget, creative testing, measurement and scale, judged on what matters, which is new paying subscribers at a healthy cost. You will also own our organic social presence: posting, community, and responding to the job seekers who talk about us. Partnering directly with the Head of Marketing, you will turn social from a channel we’ve tested into one we rely on.

  • Own paid social end to end, starting with Meta (Facebook and Instagram): strategy, account structure, audiences, bidding, budget pacing and daily optimization, then test and expand into TikTok, Reddit, YouTube and LinkedIn where the numbers support it.

  • Run community management: respond to comments, messages and reviews, and turn customer stories and feedback into content.
  • Bring our launches and seasonal moments to social, including new product features, our January job search peak, and promotions like Black Friday, in coordination with email and paid search.
  • Build retargeting and audience strategy across paid social, and coordinate with our email program so social and lifecycle work together.
  • Use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT daily to multiply creative output, speed up analysis and keep a high quality bar.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Creative strategy skills: you can explain how you find winning ads, with real examples of hooks, UGC and short-form video that worked
  • Measurement fluency: Meta Pixel, Conversions API, UTMs, GA4, attribution windows, and a healthy skepticism of platform-reported results

  • Strong writing: ad copy, hooks and posts that sound human and on brand
  • Strong AI/LLM fluency: you use Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools in your daily workflow, with a clear quality check before anything goes live
  • Self-directed and high-judgment: you can take a budget and a target and run with it without daily oversight
  • Comfortable with data: you build your own reports and draw clear conclusions from them
  • Based in the Canada, with working hours that consistently overlap US Eastern time (EST, CT, or PT)

What will make you stand out!

  • Experience in career, HR or job-search related products
  • TikTok, Reddit, YouTube or LinkedIn ads experience
  • Creator and UGC partnership management
  • Video editing (CapCut, Premiere) and light design skills (Figma, Canva)

  • SQL or BigQuery skills

Benefits

Through scientific and clinical research in Africa, India, Europe, and the U.S., IAVI is pioneering the development of biomedical innovations designed for broad global access. We develop vaccines and antibodies in and for the developing world and seek to accelerate their introduction in low-income countries. IAVI programs and partnerships are grounded in the regions of the world where the disease burden is the greatest, and our approach emphasizes sustainability. Our network of clinical research center partners in Africa and India helps strengthen in-country research capacity and supports the training and education of the next generation of scientists. The global impact of our science includes fundamental contributions to understanding the biology of HIV infection, which IAVI and others are applying toward advancing vaccine science and immunology. Our global reach, including a clinical research network in five countries in sub-Saharan Africa and in India, has allowed us to make fundamental contributions to understanding the epidemiology, transmission, virology, and immunology of HIV. This work played a key role in facilitating the design of promising HIV vaccine candidates, as well as the discovery of broadly neutralizing antibodies that are now being advanced as promising approaches for HIV prevention. Our integrated capabilities in vaccine and antibody discovery, development, and clinical research take advantage of bio-pharmaceutical industry expertise to accelerate the development and testing of prevention methods for HIV and other diseases. title: Senior Backend Engineer (Go / AWS Streaming)
description:
About us:
Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company. We help businesses re-engineer how work actually gets done by placing AI orchestrators inside their teams to redesign workflows, deploy agents, and rewire operations end-to-end.

Job Summary:
The Senior Backend Engineer builds the backbone that connects devices in the field to the data that drives decisions. Every event from every endpoint flows through systems you design.

You will build and own high-throughput backend services in Go that ingest device telemetry through AWS IoT and Kinesis, process it in real time, and land it in Redshift for analytics and reporting. Your systems have to handle spikes without losing a single event, scale without anyone stepping in, and stay cheap enough to run at volume.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. We are hiring someone who has run streaming pipelines in production, has been paged when they broke, and has made them better every time.

Job Description:

  • Build backend services in Go: You design, build, and maintain production Go services and APIs that are fast, concurrent, well tested, and easy for the next engineer to understand.
  • Own device ingestion: You build the path from device to cloud on AWS IoT Core, covering device connectivity over MQTT, authentication, message routing, and the rules that hand data off downstream.
  • Run real-time streaming pipelines: You design and operate Kinesis Data Streams and Firehose pipelines, with partitioning strategies, consumers, retries, back-pressure, and dead-letter handling. Throughput is high and no data gets lost.
  • Model and load the warehouse: You design Redshift schemas, distribution and sort keys, and loading patterns that keep queries fast as data grows. You make sure the data that lands is correct, complete, and ready for analytics.
  • Own reliability and cost: You build monitoring, alerting, and dashboards across the pipeline with CloudWatch or similar tools, and you track latency, data loss, and AWS spend. You know the cost per million events and how to bring it down.
  • Raise the engineering bar: You lead design discussions, review code, write clear technical documents, and mentor other engineers on the team.

Requirements

  • Senior backend engineer: 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with at least 2–3 years writing production Go. You understand goroutines, channels, and the concurrency patterns that hold up under load.
  • Streaming in production: You have built and operated streaming data pipelines with AWS Kinesis, or a comparable system such as Kafka, at meaningful scale. You understand ordering, partitioning, exactly-once and at-least-once delivery, and replay.
  • AWS IoT or device data: You have worked with AWS IoT Core or another device-telemetry ingestion platform, including MQTT, device authentication, and high-fan-in workloads.
  • Data warehouse experience: You have designed and optimized Amazon Redshift, or a similar warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery, for production analytics. You write strong SQL and know how to make slow queries fast.
  • Cloud and infrastructure: You are strong on AWS (Lambda, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and comfortable with infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CDK, Docker, and CI/CD.
  • Clear communicator: You can explain an architecture trade-off to a US product team in plain English and write design documents people actually read.

description:
At IEM, we’re not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we’re shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting out, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world’s most dynamic markets.

Position Summary

The Director of Strategic Procurement, reporting to our VP of Supply Chain, develops and executes enterprise procurement strategies that support IEM’s manufacturing, supply chain, operational, and business growth goals. This role is responsible for building a high-performing procurement function, improving supplier performance, driving cost reduction, reducing supply risk, and ensuring IEM has the supplier base, contracts, and processes needed to support a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

The ideal candidate has strong strategic sourcing, supplier management, procurement leadership, and manufacturing experience. This individual should be able to partner cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Operations, Planning, Engineering, Quality, Finance, and executive leadership to improve material availability, cost competitiveness, supplier accountability, and long-term business continuity.

Note: While candidates based near one of our US plants are preferred, we are open to remote candidates. This role requires approximately 50% travel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute strategic procurement plans that support cost, quality, delivery, inventory, working capital, and business continuity goals.
  • Lead procurement strategy across assigned commodities, suppliers, materials, components, and services.
  • Build, lead, coach, and develop a procurement team capable of supporting IEM’s growth, production demands, and operational priorities.
  • Establish supplier strategies that improve cost competitiveness, lead times, capacity, quality, and delivery performance.
  • Lead supplier negotiations related to pricing, contracts, payment terms, lead times, minimum order quantities, stocking agreements, blanket orders, and long-term supply agreements.
  • Drive cost reduction, supplier consolidation, dual sourcing, localization, value engineering, and supply risk mitigation initiatives.
  • Partner with Procurement, Planning, Operations, Quality, Engineering, Finance, and executive leadership to align supplier strategies with business and production needs.
  • Analyze spend, supplier performance, market trends, supplier capacity, demand signals, lead times, cost drivers, and supply risks to support sourcing and procurement decisions.
  • Establish procurement processes, tools, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms to improve visibility, accountability, and decision-making.
  • Manage supplier performance through business reviews, scorecards, corrective actions, escalation management, and long-term supplier development.
  • Support supplier issue resolution related to delivery delays, defects, nonconformance, pricing discrepancies, capacity constraints, and recurring performance concerns.
  • Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships while ensuring suppliers are held accountable to IEM’s expectations.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to support new product introduction, capacity expansion, operational improvements, and strategic business initiatives.
  • Ensure procurement data, supplier records, pricing, contracts, and sourcing documentation are accurate and maintained in applicable systems.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts related to procurement processes, supplier performance, material flow, cost reduction, and supply chain reliability.
  • The candidate will be expected to perform additional duties as assigned to support the team and organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, commodity management, supply chain, or supplier management in a manufacturing environment.
  • 5+ years of experience leading procurement, sourcing, or supply chain teams.
  • Experience developing and executing procurement strategies across multiple commodities, suppliers, or business units.
  • Strong experience leading supplier negotiations, supplier performance management, contract management, cost reduction, and supply risk mitigation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing supply chains, supplier lead times, material planning, cost drivers, inventory management, and production support.
  • Ability to make practical procurement and supplier decisions while partnering appropriately with Engineering, Quality, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain.
  • Strong leadership, analytical, negotiation, communication, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Experience building processes, KPIs, reporting tools, supplier scorecards, and procurement operating rhythms.
  • Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems, Microsoft Excel, spend analysis, and supplier performance reporting tools.
  • Demonstrated career growth and increasing responsibility, with the ability to operate as both a strategic leader and hands-on problem solver in a fast-paced, high-growth organization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in electrical equipment, power distribution, switchgear, industrial manufacturing, or engineered-to-order manufacturing.
  • Experience with supplier development, localization, Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, material flow, and value engineering concepts.
  • Experience supporting high-growth manufacturing environments with complex supplier networks and production demands.
  • CPM, CPSM, CSCP, or other procurement/supply chain certification preferred.
  • Advanced degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field preferred.

Working Conditions

  • Manufacturing and office environment.
  • May require travel to suppliers or IEM facilities.
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities, production demands, supplier constraints, and executive-level expectations.

Compensation actually offered for this role will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors.

Why Join IEM

At IEM, you’ll join a team that powers some of the world’s most ambitious projects. We’re engineers, makers, and problem-solvers who thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering solutions that keep industries moving forward. If you’re driven, collaborative, and ready to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you. Your creativity and passion can help us achieve great things—come be part of the journey.

Learn more about IEM at

title: Sr. Clinical Product Manager
description:
About Lyra Health

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

About the Role:

Lyra is at the forefront of increasing access to evidence-based, efficacious mental health services on a large scale. Lyra has developed innovative blended models of coaching and psychotherapy that combine leading clinical expertise with routine outcomes monitoring and engaging clinical digital tools. Scientific publications on Lyra’s mental health coaching (Coaching Effectiveness), (Coaching Outcomes), psychotherapy [(Blended Care effectiveness), (Examining Blended Care impact)], (medication management), and overall workforce mental health programs [(Presenteeism impact), (Impact of psychotherapy)] provide strong evidence for the clinical effectiveness of these evidence-based treatment programs.

We are looking for an experienced psychologist with a passion for writing, intervention development, and skills training to contribute to our care programs (including but not limited to our parent coaching program, other programming related to youth and families, as well as adult programs). For this role, strong expertise in child evidence-based mental health interventions is required. This position will be dedicated to writing on clinical topics and upholding a high quality bar for clinical content and programming.

You will be part of a highly skilled, creative, and collaborative team with an established track record for developing effective and engaging interventions and digital clinical materials on emotional wellness and psychotherapy skills. By directly reaching tens of thousands of clients, your work on interventions and digital clinical materials will help create meaningful positive change on a large scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Writing new, engaging clinical content including storytelling and dialogue

  • Developing clinical curriculums and outlines for digital clinical materials

  • Identifying and proposing clinical topics for materials related to evidence-based care (e.g., parenting and managing child externalizing symptoms, youth and families more broadly, adult mental well-being)

  • Reviewing, updating, and editing clinical content to ensure adherence to up-to-date treatment standards

  • Receiving and incorporating significant feedback on your proposals and writing

  • Conducting trainings to help disseminate the use of digital clinical materials

  • Collaborating cross-functionally to produce educational materials and support clinical programming

  • Completing extensive literature reviews to inform outcomes measure selection for a variety of child mental health presentations

  • Conducting presentations and reviewing written content for customers/broader public audience

Qualifications:

  • PsyD, PhD in Clinical / Counseling / School psychology

  • Must have a specialization in pediatric mental health

  • Passionate about increasing access to child mental health and family-based interventions

  • Very strong clinical training and experience with providing evidence-based treatments for child mental health across a variety of clinical presentations (e.g., behavioral parent training, behavior therapy, exposure-based CBT, IPT, ACT, DBT, ERP)

  • Excellent writer with demonstrated writing experience, passionate about writing on clinical topics

  • 3+ years of postdoctoral clinical experience in providing evidence-based treatments for child mental health disorders

  • Experience with creating clinical materials for and training providers to deliver child mental health interventions is a plus

  • Able to think outside the box to create innovative and accessible mental health solutions, openness to working with coaches and paraprofessionals to implement evidence-based skills

  • Comfortable with technology

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment - we move quickly to develop and evaluate clinical programs thus we seek people who are comfortable with constant change, feedback, and improvement

  • Independent, open-minded, non-judgmental, compassionate, and flexible, with excellent interpersonal skills (communication and listening)

  • Functions well in cross-functional contexts (collaborative); previous experience in digital mental health teams (working with Product, Engineering, Marketing, etc.) is a plus

Note on Generative AI for Applicants

While this role is dedicated to the clinical application of generative AI, we are seeking the unique clinical expertise and nuanced clinical judgment that only highly-trained clinicians can provide. As such, we ask that you do not use generative AI to develop your application materials (including cover letter) or when responding to interview questions.

title: Technical Trainer
description:
The Technical Trainer & Writer develops and manages product training and knowledge content for a complex clinical trial technology platform. This role goes beyond technical writing. It requires understanding how functionality fits into end-user workflows and the broader content ecosystem. Technical Trainer & Writer works closely with product owners, Customer Engagement, and technical team members to ensure training and knowledge materials are accurate, well-structured, and developed to a high standard.

Role Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, job aids, user guides, and training resources alongside each of the four annual software releases.

  • Use release overviews and release notes as the source of truth so content is complete and accurate at the time of each release.

  • Write clear, precise technical documentation that translates complex functionality into language users can understand.

  • Determine where new content belongs within the knowledge base, and how functionality connects across the platform, user roles, and processes.

  • Create training assets such as training presentations, training manuals, curriculum materials, and competency assessments. These are delivered as completed assets, not presented live.

  • Work with product owners, who serve as subject matter experts, to confirm accuracy. Incorporate review feedback from product owners and the Manager, Technology Training.

  • Work with the Customer Success team to build an understanding of clinical research context and the platform.

  • Keep team templates and existing materials current with the Technology Training team.

  • Support monitoring of knowledge base effectiveness.

  • Over time, grow into e-learning development, video tutorials, and other learning formats

Role Clarifications

  • This role does not include instructor-led training, in person or virtual.

  • This role does not interact directly with external customers.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of technical training and writing or documentation experience for software or SaaS platforms, including long-form technical documentation.

  • Proven ability to translate highly technical information into clear, user-friendly content.

  • Experience with a knowledge base or content management platform such as Zendesk, Confluence, or SharePoint.

  • Demonstrated technical aptitude and the ability to learn complex software quickly.

  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and critical thinking. Understands context rather than only transcribing requirements.

  • Collaborative and comfortable asking subject matter experts questions, and receptive to review and feedback.

  • A disciplined self-starter who can work independently in a remote environment.

  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to meet release deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a clinical, science, health-related, or technical communication field.

  • Experience in clinical research, life sciences, healthcare, or IT industry.

  • Experience with e-learning authoring or video tutorial tools.

  • Experience working with agile development teams and release cycles.

We work with clients across industries to solve complex business and technology challenges through practical, scalable solutions, and we place experienced operators alongside client teams to extend their capacity. An overview of this role

Reports to: Manager, Renewals

This is an individual-contributor, tactical role focused on timely, accurate execution rather than strategic decision-making. The Associate Renewals Manager works under the general direction of Senior Renewals Managers and their manager, following specific instructions and frameworks in day-to-day work. Solutions and outputs are reviewed by more senior team members and/or the direct manager.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of customer renewals tracking key dates and driving them to on-time closure.
  • Have real, consultative conversations with customers throughout the renewal cycle to understand how they're actually using the product and where they're headed next.
  • Identify and surface expansion opportunities — additional seats, tiers, or modules — that come out of those conversations.
  • Probe for new use cases and unmet needs within existing accounts, connecting what customers describe to relevant GitLab capabilities they aren't yet using.
  • Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule, structuring them to reflect any expansion identified.
  • Prepare and send renewal quotes, order forms, and related documentation accurately and on schedule.
  • Analyze moderately complex renewal situations (usage trends, contract terms, pricing) by reviewing existing account factors, escalating anything unusual to a senior team member or manager and helping to mitigate any risk identified.
  • Explain moderately complex renewal terms and issues to customers and internal stakeholders, working to build alignment.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance to help identify expansion opportunities, resolve blockers and keep renewals moving.
  • Communicate proactively and transparently with customers and internal stakeholders, adapting to GitLab's communication framework.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in the CRM/renewals system for forecasting and reporting.
  • Prioritize tasks with guidance from more senior team members to drive quality, timely results.
  • Contribute to team goals by working collaboratively with peer RM’s.

What You’ll Bring

  • Can execute basic renewal processes independently ("basic knots") and has been introduced to more advanced scenarios ("complex knots") such as multi-year deals, upsell-attached renewals, or non-standard terms.
  • Developing understanding of GitLab's way of working, values, and high-performance culture.
  • Awareness of GitLab's remote work best practices.
  • Growth mindset and sense of ownership — proactively seeks out ways to learn and improve, and takes action rather than waiting for direction.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing many renewals at once.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to follow defined processes and frameworks while flagging exceptions appropriately.
  • Collaborative mindset and openness to feedback and coaching from senior teammates and manager.
  • The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.

About the team

The Renewals team focuses on protecting and growing GitLab's recurring revenue by managing the full contract lifecycle for our subscription customers. As a Renewal Manager, you'll be part of a quota-carrying team that works closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal to ensure timely, accurate renewals and strong customer retention across regions in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. The team is responsible for forecasting renewal outcomes, identifying and addressing churn risk, and uncovering opportunities to expand GitLab adoption, while continuously improving processes and best practices that support predictable, sustainable growth.

title: New Business Manager
description:
Our company

Surfer is an AI Visibility Platform that helps marketing teams become the definitive answer wherever their buyers search — across Google and AI search. The platform combines data, research-backed optimization, and a user-friendly workflow to grow brand visibility through content where buying decisions start to form.

Surfer is used by content marketers, SEO specialists, agencies, and in-house marketing teams around the world to track, plan, write, and optimize content that gets ranked and cited by both search engines and LLMs.

Surfer is part of Positive Group - a fast-growing tech group specializing in B2B SaaS products that help marketing teams grow smarter. The group brings together several brands around a common ambition: to become the European benchmark in MarTech. With around 400 employees based in France, Germany, Italy, and Poland, Positive supports customers in 80+ countries.

We’re a remote-first company, but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław , Poland where the magic happens (and coffee never runs out ☕).


About the role

We're looking for someone who's worked at a marketing/SEO agency or a martech company and knows what it takes to close - someone who picks up the phone without thinking twice, and who hasn't been trained out of that instinct by years of "process."

On a day-to-day basis, you'll own the new-business side end-to-end: prospecting and building your own pipeline, working the leads that come your way, qualifying them, running discovery and demos, negotiating, and closing. You'll work closely with the Customer Success team, and get support from Marketing and RevOps. This role rewards initiative - the more you build and close, the more it shows, both in your results and in what you earn.

You will be responsible for:

  • Work both sides of the pipeline: reaching out to existing leads in our CRM (conference, meetup, webinar, and community signals plus records of past interest) while building a new pipeline from scratch through your own outbound prospecting.

  • Prospect actively: research target accounts, identify decision-makers, and open conversations with agencies and in-house teams that haven’t reached out to us yet.

  • Run multi-channel outreach on these leads across email, LinkedIn, and phone.

  • Build and continuously refine ICP-aligned contact lists covering both marketing/SEO agencies and in-house SEO/marketing teams at companies.

  • Qualify leads and run discovery calls, demos, and negotiations, owning the deal through to signed contract and payment.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 4 years of B2B sales experience as an SDR/BDR/AE at a marketing/SEO agency, a martech company (e.g. SEO, content, analytics, or marketing automation software), or at a company selling into agencies.

  • Proven track record of closing deals end-to-end, including negotiation and contracting.

  • Familiarity with the SEO/content marketing space (content briefs, topical authority, SERPs).

  • No hesitation picking up the phone the moment a lead is worth chasing.

  • Motivated by closing deals, not just running a process. You know the satisfaction of seeing a deal through from first call to signed contract - and you want more of that.

  • Outreach experience across email, LinkedIn, and phone.

  • Familiarity with CRM and sales/outbound tools.

  • Strong written and verbal English (C1 or above).

  • Nice to have: experience selling a SaaS product (not a service); ABM (account-based marketing/sales) experience.

What we offer:

We build the team around experts and stay out of their way. That starts with the basics:

Compensation: $36,000–45,500/year base (excl. VAT, where applicable), plus a bonus system.

Contract: We work exclusively on B2B (contractor) agreements. This means you’ll need your own registered business (e.g. sole proprietorship / self-employed status in your country) and will invoice us monthly.

We take care of the things that matter outside the work itself - your health, your rest, the setup that lets you work well, and the chance to sharpen your craft. Everything else follows from how we operate: trust over control, outcomes over hours.

Location and Remote Work:

We’re a remote-first company, but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław, Poland.
